children.title: Cycle 11 · Revision of Autocatalytic Memory Notebook with Stoichiometric and Network Evidence

detail.title: Revision of Autocatalytic Memory Notebook with Stoichiometric and Network Evidence
detail.summary: This proposal submits a revised notebook for the autocatalytic-memory-mechanisms project, integrating newly retrieved evidence regarding stoichiometric conditions and reaction network subgraphs that support irreducible autocatalytic systems.
